277785001_dbe782a3.text: the intrinsic connections of GABAergic dLGN interneurons

277785001_d5f8258d.text: In the dLGN, synaptic terminals originating from the PT targeted interneurons more frequently than thalamocortical (relay) cells, and optogenetic activation of PT input had a greater impact on interneuron firing frequency compared with relay cells. This cell type- specific impact of PT input to the dLGN resulted in the disinhibition of relay cells and an increase in the amplitude of their postsynaptic responses to retinal input.
